ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level ratio of high-intensity white pixels (approximately 15%) to low-intensity dark pixels (approximately 85%) across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dark grayscale base with high-contrast white linear mottling and focal clusters. White markings are most concentrated at the medial hinge point and as discrete segments scattered across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped indentation with an estimated vertex angle of 50 degrees and a bounding box depth representing approximately 20% of the vertical fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile along the trailing edge boundary with pixel-height variations ranging from 5 to 15 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex mathematical curve fitted to the posterior margins of both lobes, transitioning to a sharp taper at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatially clustered, high-contrast circular pixel groups (barnacle colonies) concentrated at the distal tip of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense array of unaligned white linear tracks (rake marks) crossing the dark pigment, with lengths ranging from 20 to 80 pixels across the ventral surface of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake mark scarring across the majority of the ventral surface and localized barnacle colonization on the far left distal tip.
